applyTo: "**/*.md,**/*.cpp,**/*.h,**/*.hpp"
description: "Documentation requirements for embedded systems project"

# Documentation Requirements

## Code Documentation
- Document all public APIs with clear parameter descriptions and return values
- Explain hardware timing requirements and constraints
- Document interrupt service routines and their purposes
- Include examples of proper usage for complex interfaces

## Hardware Documentation
- Maintain accurate pin assignment tables
- Document I2C addresses and communication protocols
- Include wiring diagrams or references to circuit schematics
- Specify power requirements and operating conditions

## Project Documentation
- Keep README.md current with setup and build instructions
- Document dependencies and library requirements
- Provide troubleshooting guides for common issues
- Include performance characteristics and limitations

## API Documentation
- Use consistent documentation format for function signatures
- Document preconditions and postconditions for functions
- Explain error codes and exception conditions
- Provide usage examples for complex operations

## Hardware Interface Documentation
- Document register maps and bit field definitions
- Explain communication protocols and timing requirements
- Include state machine diagrams for complex sequences
- Document calibration procedures and configuration steps

## Maintenance Documentation
- Document known issues and workarounds
- Maintain changelog for version tracking
- Include debugging guides and diagnostic procedures
- Document upgrade and migration procedures

## User Documentation
- Provide clear setup and installation instructions
- Include user guides for configuration and operation
- Document safety considerations and limitations
- Provide contact information for support and issues
